run_resynthesis_cli: run the resynthesis script to encode audio into discrete units and resynthesize it back
build_speech_encoder: build a SpeechEncoder from pretrained dense and quantizer model names with a given vocab size
encode_audio_to_units: encode an audio waveform into a stream of deduplicated discrete units using a SpeechEncoder
resynthesize_units_to_audio: resynthesize discrete units back into audio using a TacotronVocoder and save the output
calculate_compression_rate: calculate the uniform and unigram bits-per-second compression rate for encoded discrete units
